item.title: Meduza: Russian drones strike Kyiv’s Southern Bridge in first attack on the city’s bridges since the full-scale invasion. A subway train was crossing it at the time.
item.description: Russian forces are keeping up their drone attacks on Kyiv. On the morning of October 1, a drone struck a school building in the Solomianskyi district. The students were in a shelter at the time and were unharmed. Later that day, Russian forces attacked bridges in Kyiv with drones for the first time since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine began. Two drones struck the Southern Bridge, which carries both road traffic and subway trains.

item.title: Meduza: Proekt investigation finds Russian officials flying on private jets apparently provided by oligarchs whose industries they oversee
item.description: Proekt has published an extensive investigation into senior Russian officials’ use of private jets. Its journalists examined a database from the border service of Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) that leaked in 2023. It contained records of more than 100 million people who left Russia by air or other means in 2014–2023. The reporters spent a year analyzing international flight records for 1,064 senior Russian officials. We briefly summarize the investigation’s most important findings.
